title: Jets’ 2026 NFL Draft mission is clear: Build the roster for next franchise quarterback

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets’ 2026 NFL Draft mission is clear: Build the roster for next franchise quarterback
sources.description: The Jets want to have an environment cultivated for their next franchise QB's development. That, after Thursday's first night of the 2026 NFL Draft, they’re well on their way to creating.
